treatment_summary: Start dapagliflozin 10 mg daily as first‑line therapy because metformin is contraindicated by low eGFR. Add semaglutide 0.25 mg weekly for additional glucose control, weight loss and cardiovascular benefit, titrating as tolerated. Switch from premixed insulin to basal insulin glargine 10 U at bedtime, reducing the dose by ~10–20% when dapagliflozin and semaglutide are introduced to mitigate hypoglycaemia. Continue lisinopril for hypertension and renal protection. Monitor HbA1c q‑3‑6 months, renal function and electrolytes after drug initiation, fasting glucose daily during titration, and perform annual foot, retinal and lipid assessments. Address data gaps (eGFR confirmation, lipid profile/QRISK, infection history, allergies) before finalising the plan.
